stories.title: Gibbons two-year ban slashed on appeal
stories.subTitle: Will now miss eight games
stories.summary: Treadwell Gibbons Jr. has had his two-year ban overturned on appeal by the Bermuda Cricket Board and will instead have to sit out eight matches

stories.title: Sibanda hundred secures victory for Zimbabwe
stories.subTitle: Bermuda v Zimbabwe, Tri-Nation ODI final , Trinidad
stories.summary: As expected, Zimbabwe cruised to victory over Bermuda in the final of the Tri-Nation tournament at Queen's Park Oval, Vusi Sibanda's hundred giving them a total that was never likely to be overtaken

stories.title: Zimbabwe crush Bermuda in dress rehersal
stories.subTitle: Bermuda v Zimbabwe, Tri-Nation ODI, Trinidad
stories.summary: Zimbabwe crushed Bermuda by 194 runs at Queen's Park Oval in a low-key dress rehearsal for Saturday's tournament final
